details.label: Extended Outlook
details.text: Monday through Saturday. The approach and passage of a stronger low pressure system Friday may result in breezy to strong wind gusts. If confidence increases in these gusts reaching Advisory (46 mph or greater) or Warning (58 mph or greater) criteria, those headlines may be needed. Additionally, low probability scenarios exist where lake effect snow develops Saturday that could result in accumulating snow favoring northwest Pennsylvania and the higher terrain.
